title: Safari and Beach Honeymoon in Tanzania
excerpt: The classic honeymoon in Tanzania: first a safari, then the beach. How to plan it and what makes it special.
body:
Safari followed by beach is the most popular honeymoon combination in Tanzania.

## The order

Safari first: early mornings and travel. Beach last: rest and romance.

## Safari

Choose intimate tented camps and plan three to four locations. Add a [balloon flight](/blog/serengeti-balloon-safari/) or a [bush dinner](/blog/bush-dinner-serengeti/).

## Beach

Zanzibar, Pemba or a small island. See [a honeymoon on Zanzibar](/blog/zanzibar-honeymoon/).

## Length

Twelve to sixteen days is ideal.

## Season

June to October and December to February are the driest. See [Tanzania weather by month](/blog/tanzania-weather-by-month/).

## Example

See our [12-day honeymoon](/itineraries/12-day-honeymoon-tanzania-and-zanzibar/) or read our [honeymoon page](/tanzania-honeymoon/). [Plan your honeymoon](/travel-proposal/).
